plugins.name: Gift cards
plugins.description: Issue gift cards, inspect redemption details, and redeem points on a dedicated account page.
plugins.descriptionZh: 发行卡密、查看卡密全文与使用情况，并提供独立的账户兑换页面。

plugins.name: Solana payments
plugins.description: Purchase points with Mainnet USDT by default or optional SOL, using locked amounts and finalized on-chain settlement. Existing payments continue while sales are paused.
plugins.descriptionZh: 优先使用 Solana 主网 USDT 购买积分，也可使用 SOL；链上最终确认后自动入账，暂停销售仍处理已有订单。

plugins.name: Commissions and contracts
plugins.description: Stage-based commissions, versioned contract templates, private files and administrator-signed Mainnet evidence.
plugins.descriptionZh: 阶段化委托、版本化合同模板、私有附件与管理员主网存证；交付存证完成后开始维护。
